title: Pro Basketball League Round 4 of Finals. Oostende lift the trophy
description: Mechelen - Oostende 83-91 Oostende claimed Pro Basketball League title. They upset Mechelen on the road in Game 4 to lift the trophy. Kangoeroes were trailing by 1 point at halftime but managed to get 1-point lead after three quarters before a 28-19 charge of Oostende, which allowed them to win the game. They dominated down low during the game scoring 62 of its points in the paint compared to Kangoeroes' 38. American guard Phil Booth (190-1995, college: Villanova) fired 26 points for the winners. Dutch point guard Keye Van Der Vuurst (191-2001) chipped in 13 points, 5 rebounds and 8 assists. Oostende's coach Dario Gjergja used a ten-player rotation which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games.
